prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1397; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim documentation purposes. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just keep it simple. You can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That works. Can you walk me through what happened in the parking lot in League City?

A: I was pulling into a space near the store entrance. It was busy, so I was going slow, maybe five miles an hour. Another car backed out of a spot on my right without really looking, and the rear corner of their car clipped the front passenger side of mine.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: Not until it was already moving. I braked as soon as I saw it, but there wasn't enough room to avoid it.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: No, they didn't. The impact wasn't that hard. I jerked forward and my right arm hit the steering wheel and the door frame.

Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?

A: I went to urgent care that afternoon. They took X-rays and said my wrist was fractured. They put me in a splint and gave me a follow-up appointment with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that wrist or arm?

A: No, nothing before this. I'm right-handed, and I've been having a hard time typing and doing everyday things since.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'd like to get my car repaired as soon as possible, since I rely on it for work.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the statement.
